identity.title: Beaver Valley Power Station, Unit No. 1 Docket No. 50-334, License No. DPR-66 LER 2021-001-00

cause.proximate_text: The direct technical cause was that 1QS-4 was restrained out of NSA per procedure 1OM-13.4.O and not returned to NSA following filling of the loop seal. The root cause was a loss of configuration control of valve 1QS-4 due to human performance errors by the Operations supervisor, who did not meet the requirements of procedure 1/2-ADM-2028, "Temporary Configuration Control," and procedure NOP-OP-1002, "Conduct of Operations," for logging system conditions.

nodes.display_name: 1QS-4 (Train B Quench Spray Pump Discharge Check Valve)
MOV-1QS-101B (Train B Outside Containment Isolation Valve)
1QS-4 restrained open per procedure 1OM-13.4.O for loop seal fill
nodes.description: Check valve 1QS-4 restrained open by swing arm to support gravity filling of quench spray loop seal from RWST.

nodes.display_name: Non-NSA position not logged / working procedure misplaced
nodes.description: No log entry made per NOP-OP-1002 documenting the non-NSA position of 1QS-4; working copy of 1OM-13.4.O was misplaced, leading supervisor to assume restoration steps were complete.

nodes.display_name: 1QS-4 not returned to NSA prior to mode entry
nodes.description: Restraint on 1QS-4 was not removed prior to entering a mode of applicability for containment isolation TS LCO 3.6.3.

nodes.display_name: Containment penetration inoperable / TS LCO 3.6.3 not met / entered Modes 4 and 3 without meeting LCO 3.0.4
Remove restraint and return 1QS-4 to normal system arrangement
Revise 1OM-13.4.O to require adding 1QS-3/1QS-4 to containment penetration log when restrained open

chain: loss of configuration control / logging failure [cause TBD] -> 1QS-4 restrained open for loop seal fill -> non-NSA position not logged / procedure misplaced -> 1QS-4 not returned to NSA before mode entry -> containment penetration inoperable, LCO 3.6.3/3.0.4 not met for 11h45m
notes: Cause code is TBD/provisional per form-366 fields despite narrative attributing root cause to human performance/configuration control errors; category left as 'provisional' per rule 4. No block_13 data provided in source fields. Quench spray train B remained operable throughout (per narrative) but this refers to the pump system function, not a backup to the containment isolation function itself, so no BACKED_UP_BY edge was asserted for containment isolation. MOV-1QS-101B modeled as component since it is the outside isolation valve for the same penetration and referenced in recovery procedures, not as a backup system. No previous similar events per LER text (three-year review found none) so no stub LER/SIMILAR_TO edge emitted.
